items.title: Guided cemetery setup flow is reachable
items.precondition: Dev server is running at http://127.0.0.1:1616 and the smoke test signs in as the seeded admin user.
steps: 1. Run node qa/map-editor-layered-smoke.mjs.
2. Open /map-editor as admin.
3. Assert the Layout setup panel exposes Map reference, Site plan, Blocks, Lots, Tiers, and Review with plain action hints.
items.expected: The map editor renders a canvas and the default sidebar presents a progressive guided setup flow instead of a technical toolbox.

items.title: Base map, site-plan, and advanced controls are properly separated
items.precondition: Same browser smoke session as T1.
steps: 1. In the smoke test, assert advanced block and layer management is hidden by default.
2. Inspect Map reference mode for view-only satellite and reset controls.
3. Switch to Site Plan mode and assert upload, compare, opacity, lock, and position controls are available.
4. Switch to Blocks, open Lot layout, and assert Rearrange existing lots is available beside new-lot generation.
5. Expand Advanced tools and assert detailed Layers and Blocks panels remain reachable.
items.expected: Base map controls stay view-only, site-plan alignment and existing-lot rearrangement are reachable from guided steps, and advanced inventory controls are available only after explicit expansion.

items.title: Rectangle block, lot, overlay transforms, and existing-lot rearrangement preserve inventory identity
items.precondition: Focused QA runs against local TypeScript source through vite-node.
steps: 1. Run npx vite-node qa/map-editor-alignment.ts.
2. Assert block move/resize/rotate updates block geometry.
3. Assert lot footprints remain tier-sized and sold-lot business fields are preserved.
4. Assert rearranging existing lots maps the same lot records onto the current grid while preserving sold-lot identity/status/client/contract/capacity data.
5. Assert overlay move/resize/rotate changes only overlay draft geometry.
items.expected: Geometry changes are visual and draft-only, with lot identity/status/client/contract/capacity data unchanged.

items.title: Exact lot count and tier footprint rules are enforced
items.precondition: Focused QA uses the same grid and geometry helpers consumed by the map editor.
steps: 1. Run npx vite-node qa/map-editor-alignment.ts.
2. Assert a rows-by-columns grid can be capped by exactCount.
3. Assert existing-lot rearrangement is blocked when the current planned grid has fewer slots than existing lots.
4. Assert tier mismatch blocks publish and resizing to tier widthM/lengthM resolves the mismatch.
items.expected: Generated placeholder count honors exact count, and tier dimensions remain the lot footprint source of truth.

items.title: Invalid geometry blocks Publish and is visible in review
items.precondition: Browser smoke and focused QA have access to seeded map-editor data.
steps: 1. Run node qa/map-editor-layered-smoke.mjs.
2. Switch to Review mode.
3. Run npx vite-node qa/map-editor-alignment.ts for overlap, outside-block, and tier-footprint conflict assertions.
items.expected: Review either reports no blockers or explains publish blocking, while focused QA proves invalid layouts cannot publish.
items.evidence: node qa/map-editor-layered-smoke.mjs -> map-editor-guided-smoke-ok; npx vite-node qa/map-editor-alignment.ts -> map-editor-alignment-ok

items.title: Repository verification suite passes
steps: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json.
2. Run npm run build.
3. Run npm run lint.
4. Run npm run validate:mock.
items.expected: Typecheck, build, lint, and mock validation all exit 0.
items.evidence: tsc exit 0; build exit 0; lint exit 0 with existing warnings; validate:mock exit 0
items.notes: Lint still reports existing warnings in unrelated files, including fast-refresh and unused-variable warnings.
